BiblicalUsage: The ark is the chest of the covenant, and it goes where God goes. Bezalel makes it of shittim wood overlaid with gold, it goes before Israel into the Jordan, it is taken by the Philistines in battle, and David brings it up to Jerusalem with gladness when he hears God has blessed the house that kept it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ark matters because it is the throne of the unseen King in the middle of His people: mercy seat, manna, and the tables of the law all in one box. It could not be handled lightly, and it could not be left behind, and I hold that Christ is the true ark now, God's presence with us, carried into every Jordan we have to cross.
